name: Mage - Arcane Architect
description: Transforming the Mage from a static ranged caster into a spatial network engineer routing magical artillery through dynamic waypoints. You abandon direct-target casting to deploy a network of Arcane Relays across the battlefield, safely copying and amplifying spells from behind cover.

bonuses.text: Feedback Loop deals 15% increased damage to targets caught inside the relay network.

items.name: Prism of the Router
items.stats:
+140 Intellect
+115 Haste
Equip: Replaces Arcane Missiles with Deploy Relay, allowing you to place up to three floating crystal nodes.
items.flavor: The refocused facets now splinter single beams into a thousand stars.

origin.details: Drops from an arcane anomaly boss in a mid-tier magical dungeon (e.g., Dire Maul or Karazhan crypts).

catalyst.details: Recut the internal geometry, and realign the local leylines within the stone to allow it to receive spell signals.

items.name: Mantle of the Node-Walker
items.stats:
+130 Intellect
+105 Mastery
Equip: Upgrades Blink. Instead of blinking a set distance forward, you instantly swap physical positions with any active Arcane Relay.
items.flavor: Physical space is merely a suggestion to those who weave the leys.

origin.details: A rare drop from an elite spell-weaver in an endgame crystalline zone.

catalyst.details: Weave new phase-spider silk into the lining, while bathing the fabric in a stabilizing mana-potion wash.

items.name: Conduit of the Nexus
items.stats:
+195 Intellect
+140 Critical Strike
Equip: Unlocks Feedback Loop. Overload the network, causing deployed relays to chain massive damage between each other before shattering.
items.flavor: A web of pure destruction, held together by exhausted exhaust vents.

catalyst.details: Carve a new channel through the wood, and install thermal exhaust vents to prevent the staff from detonating in the Mage's hands.
